how_to_score: Score each question 0, 1 or 2 from hook.jpg, sheet.jpg and the script. 0 is no, 1 is partly, 2 is clearly yes. Quote what you saw.
weak_if: The total is under 8 of 12, or question 1 or 2 scores 0.

questions.ask: With the sound off, does frame 0 tell a stranger what this is about?
questions.why: Most people decide before they hear a word.

questions.ask: Does the first spoken sentence land the claim, number or conflict within about 14 words?
questions.why: A hook that warms up first loses the viewer before it starts.

questions.ask: Would someone who has never heard of this account or niche care?
questions.why: Non-followers are where the reach comes from. Insider words shut them out.

questions.ask: Does the picture move in the first second, and does it show the same thing the words say?
questions.why: A still opening reads as a slideshow. Picture and words that disagree read as noise.

questions.ask: Does the hook open a question that only the end of the reel closes, and does the reel really close it?
questions.why: That gap is the reason to keep watching. A hook the reel doesn't pay off earns the scroll next time.

questions.ask: Are the captions and label easy to read, clear of the red zones, and not covering the main object?
questions.why: Red zones sit under Instagram's own buttons.

also_check: Every number and claim has a source in script.json, and the reel doesn't promise views or results.
No drawn people or animals unless the user asked for them.
If the voice is AI, remind the user to use Instagram's AI label when it applies.
